title: A cross-repo measure fetches the child clone first, or refuses and names the stale ref
why: Runner 9's 22:54 CST Nov 7 measure ran `ci-job --lint` against stale child clones, and started lane lane-lint-reads-child-workflows on a false premise. Fresh clones of degen, joyous and ios-adblock already had the checks job. ste-changed already exits 3 with "pull claude-settings" on its own copy, and that note did not stop runner 9.
note: Covers `ci-job --lint` run against a child clone, and ste-changed. Done check: a red test where a measure on a clone behind its origin fetches first, or refuses and names the stale ref. Waits under the item 384 hold. Slug from the coordinator, 23:10 CST; title by triage.
